case.summary: Case ALR-013 was triggered by the real-time model scoring online transaction 3526826 at 0.76 for an amount of $35.66. The graph and case memory showed that all 900 alerts raised by this score alone historically cleared as false alarms, and the case-memory model gave the transaction a calibrated fraud rate of 0.5% with an initial fraud probability of 0.01. Furthermore, the cardholder confirmed the transaction as their own during the simulated step-up authentication. The verdict is legitimate and the case was closed with no fraud, with the transaction allowed under rule R3.
